title: The sixth Schur number is at least 538
description: We give an explicit partition of {1, ..., 538} into six sum-free sets. This shows S(6) ≥ 538 and improves the bound S(6) ≥ 537 of Chen, Zhu and Long. It also gives R_6(3) ≥ 540 for the Ramsey number of the triangle in six colours. The partition is checked directly and in Lean 4. The paper is paper/schur-six-538.pdf in this archive.
